_comment: Derived from Bodycam/Content/GM/Gamemode/*.uasset (GM_Menu excluded, it's not a playable mode). team_based controls whether the UI shows a Team Cap field. Default caps for 'working' modes are the shipped DataAsset defaults, confirmed live. 'status' is one of: working (confirmed hostable and plays correctly); untested (class exists, never attempted); no_content (class/asset reference exists -- LoadAsset+StaticFindObject resolves it -- but hosting into it demonstrably does not engage it as the active gamemode, i.e. it's a leftover/stub reference with no real playable content behind it, NOT a bug in working content); broken (it DOES engage as the active gamemode but something is actually wrong during play). See 'note' on any non-working entry for why, and docs/INTERNALS.md section 5.3 for the full live-testing history. Every status is still listed (not hidden) so nothing about the game's own content is hidden from the Host tab -- the Gamemode picker groups by this field and shows the note for whichever one is selected.

Zombie.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07, via LoadAsset+StaticFindObject). Per the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game (2026-09-07, not independently live-confirmed by hosting into it): the content isn't actually implemented/updated in the current build, only the class reference and supporting data (DT_ZombieMapInfo, DT_UI_ZombieMaps rows 'Assylum'/'Village') exist. Not worth live-testing further -- see gamemodes.json's status comment for what no_content means.

Pit.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Per the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game (2026-09-07, not independently live-confirmed): content isn't implemented/updated, only the class reference and DT_UI_PitMaps rows 'Pit'/'Logistics' exist. Not worth live-testing further.

OnlyPistol.note: Class confirmed to exist (2026-09-07). Travel attempts on the known-good AirSoft map did not engage the class (stayed on GM_Bodycam_C), consistent with the app maintainer's own knowledge of the game: the content isn't implemented/updated, only the class reference exists. Not worth live-testing further.

Training.note: Confirmed live 2026-09-07: hosting this on 'Shooting Range' changes the level (get_current_level_name() correctly shows ShootingRange) but the gamemode never actually switches (get_live_state() still reports GM_Bodycam_C) -- i.e. the class exists but isn't wired up as a real hostable mode, not a bug in working content. Practical result of trying anyway: falling endlessly with no way out but quitting. Likely a practice-range backdrop not meant to be entered via servertravel. Do not use from the Host tab.
